description: Compliance dates for the AI Act and GDPR, each tied to the provision that establishes it. Entries marked verbatim=true carry a quote that tests/test_corpus_facts.py locates in the vendored corpus, so a date cannot drift away from its legal basis without failing the suite. Entries marked verbatim=false are arithmetic or inference from a quoted provision; their reasoning is stated in full.

deadlines.subject: The AI Act enters into force.
deadlines.quote: This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union
deadlines.reasoning: Published in OJ L of 12 July 2024. The twentieth day following publication is 1 August 2024. Entry into force is distinct from application: almost no substantive obligation bound anyone on this date.

deadlines.subject: General application date. Applies to every provision without its own date in Art. 113.
deadlines.reasoning: The residual rule. Article 113 then carves out four groups that depart from it.

deadlines.subject: Chapters I and II: general provisions, AI literacy, and the Article 5 prohibited practices.
deadlines.quote: Chapters I and II shall apply from 2 February 2025
deadlines.reasoning: The prohibitions bound operators eighteen months before the general application date. Note the carve-out added by the Digital Omnibus, recorded separately as aia_art5_new_prohibitions.

deadlines.subject: The prohibited practices newly inserted by the Digital Omnibus: Art. 5(1) first subparagraph points (ba) and (bb), and Art. 5(1a) and (1b).
deadlines.quote: Article 5(1a) and (1b) which shall apply from 2 December 2026
deadlines.reasoning: These prohibitions did not exist in the original text, so they could not share the 2 February 2025 date of the chapter that now contains them. A model answering from memory of the original AI Act will not know they exist.

deadlines.subject: Chapter III Section 4 (notifying authorities), Chapter V (general-purpose AI models), Chapter VII (governance), Chapter XII (penalties) and Art. 78, excluding Art. 101.
deadlines.quote: Chapter III Section 4, Chapter V, Chapter VII and Chapter XII and Article 78 shall apply from 2 August 2025, with the exception of Article 101
deadlines.reasoning: Chapter XII carries Articles 99 and 100, so the national penalty regime and the EDPS fines have applied since 2 August 2025. Article 101 is expressly excluded and is recorded separately.

deadlines.subject: Article 101: Commission fines on providers of general-purpose AI models.
deadlines.legal_basis: AI Act Art. 113(b) exclusion, falling to Art. 113 second paragraph
deadlines.reasoning: Article 113(b) excludes Article 101 from the 2 August 2025 group and gives it no date of its own. It therefore falls back to the general application date of 2 August 2026. This is a common error: Article 101 is frequently reported as applying from 2 August 2025 alongside the rest of Chapter XII.

deadlines.subject: High-risk obligations for systems classified under Art. 6(2) and Annex III (employment, education, credit, biometrics, essential services, and the rest).
deadlines.quote: 2 December 2027 as regards AI systems classified as high-risk pursuant to Article 6(2) and Annex III
deadlines.reasoning: Deferred by the Digital Omnibus. Under the original text Annex III systems had no dedicated date and so fell to the general date of 2 August 2026; the obligation was moved back by roughly sixteen months.

deadlines.subject: High-risk obligations for systems classified under Art. 6(1) and Annex I (AI as a safety component of a product already covered by Union harmonisation law).
deadlines.quote: 2 August 2028 as regards AI systems classified as high-risk pursuant to Article 6(1) and Annex I
deadlines.reasoning: Deferred by the Digital Omnibus from 2 August 2027 by one year.

deadlines.subject: Articles 102 to 110: the consequential amendments to other Union legislation.
deadlines.quote: Articles 102 to 110 shall apply from 27 July 2026.
deadlines.reasoning: Inserted by the Digital Omnibus and aligned with its own entry into force.

deadlines.subject: Original date for Art. 6(1) high-risk obligations, before the Digital Omnibus.
deadlines.legal_basis: AI Act Art. 113(c) as originally published
deadlines.quote: Article 6(1) and the corresponding obligations in this Regulation shall apply from 2 August 2027.
deadlines.reasoning: Retained so the assistant can show what changed rather than merely assert it. Any answer citing this date as current law is wrong as of 27 July 2026.

deadlines.subject: Original position for Art. 6(2) and Annex III high-risk obligations, before the Digital Omnibus.
deadlines.legal_basis: AI Act Art. 113 second paragraph as originally published
deadlines.reasoning: The original Art. 113(c) gave a dedicated date only to Article 6(1). Annex III high-risk systems therefore had no carve-out and fell to the general application date of 2 August 2026. The Digital Omnibus gave them an explicit date of 2 December 2027.

deadlines.subject: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 enters into force and the amendments to the AI Act take effect.
deadlines.quote: This Regulation shall enter into force on the third day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union
deadlines.reasoning: Signed at Strasbourg on 8 July 2026. The consolidated AI Act carries the consolidation date 27 July 2026 (CELEX 02024R1689-20260727), which fixes entry into force at that date, and Art. 113(d) independently gives 27 July 2026 for Articles 102 to 110.

deadlines.subject: The GDPR applies in full, including the Article 83 administrative fines.
deadlines.reasoning: Included so that questions spanning both regulations can be answered on a common timeline.
